jp_grezzo: "「…これが…君の望んでいた結果？」"

jp_grezzo: "「ほどほどに」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("You got dirty.")

jp: 「まだ脳のデフラグが終わらないのか」
jp_grezzo: "「まだ脳のデフラグが終わらないのか」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Haven't you finished defragmenting your brain yet?")
it: Non hai ancora finito di deframmentare il cervello?

jp: 「スリープ状態の意識にアクセスしてみたが…ふむ」
jp_grezzo: "「スリープ状態の意識にアクセスしてみたが…ふむ」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Do androids dream of electric sheep?")
it: Ho provato ad accedere alla tua coscienza in sospensione... hm.

jp: 「夢か。私にもそんなものを見ていた頃があったな…」
jp_grezzo: "「夢か。私にもそんなものを見ていた頃があったな…」"
en: There was a time when I was dreaming too...
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("There was a time when I was dreaming too...")

jp: 「アハハ！休息は楽しめているかしら？」
jp_grezzo: "「アハハ！休息は楽しめているかしら？」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Aha! Are you enjoying your break?")
it: Ahaha! Ti stai godendo il riposo?

jp: 「夢だからメチャクチャにしてもいいわよね」
jp_grezzo: "「夢だからメチャクチャにしてもいいわよね」"
en: It's a dream, so no safe words, alright?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("It's a dream, so no safe words, alright?")
it: È un sogno, quindi posso fare a pezzi tutto, no?

jp: 「生きたままシルフ達に食われる夢へ変えてやってもいいのよ」
jp_grezzo: "「生きたままシルフ達に食われる夢へ変えてやってもいいのよ」"
en: Shall I add some hungry sylphs to your dream?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Shall I add some hungry sylphs to your dream?")

jp: 「…魔法を授けに来たわけではない」
jp_grezzo: "「…魔法を授けに来たわけではない」"
en: ...I did not bring a spell, but a blessing.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("...I did not bring a spell, but a blessing.")
it: ...Non sono venuto a concederti una magia.

jp: 「夢幻の中にあっても高らかに我が名を唱えよ」
jp_grezzo: "「夢幻の中にあっても高らかに我が名を唱えよ」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Chant my name proudly even in a dream.")
it: Canta alto il mio nome anche dentro il sogno.

jp: 「汝、深き眠りの異界を目指すのならば一切の畏れを捨てよ」
jp_grezzo: "「汝、深き眠りの異界を目指すのならば一切の畏れを捨てよ」"
en: If you want to reach the otherworld of deep sleep, throw away all fear.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("If you want to reach the otherworld of deep sleep, throw away all fear.")

jp: 「あそぼ！あそぼ！」
jp_grezzo: "「あそぼ！あそぼ！」"
en: Let's play! Play!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Let's play! Play!")

jp_grezzo: "「うっみゅーん！寝てるの？本当に寝てるの？」"
en: Meooow? Are you sleeping? Are you really sleeping?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Meooow? Are you sleeping? Are you really sleeping?")
it: Miaooo! Stai dormendo? Ma davvero stai dormendo?

jp: 「紫色の羊さんには気をつけてね！てね！」
jp_grezzo: "「紫色の羊さんには気をつけてね！てね！」"
en: Be careful of the purple sheep! Sheep!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Be careful of the purple sheep! Sheep!")
it: Occhio alle pecore viola! Viola!

jp: 「フゥハハハハーッ！胸を貸そう」
jp_grezzo: "「フゥハハハハーッ！胸を貸そう」"
en: Mwahahaha! Dream wrestling time!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Mwahahaha! Dream wrestling time!")
it: Mwahahahaa! È l'ora della lotta nel sogno!

jp: 「フハハハ！付いて来たぞぉ、夢の中までも！」
jp_grezzo: "「フハハハ！付いて来たぞぉ、夢の中までも！」"
en: Muwahaha! I've come here, in your dreams!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Muwahaha! I've come here, in your dreams!")
it: Mwahahaha! Ti ho seguito fin qui, dentro il sogno!

jp: 「フハー！ドリーム・イメージトレーニングの時間だっ」
jp_grezzo: "「フハー！ドリーム・イメージトレーニングの時間だっ」"
en: Muha! It's time for dream image training.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Muha! It's time for dream image training.")
it: Mwahaa! È l'ora dell'allenamento mentale da sogno.

jp: 「ち、ちゃんと寝てるか確認しに来ただけなんだから！」
jp_grezzo: "「ち、ちゃんと寝てるか確認しに来ただけなんだから！」"
en: I was just making sure you were sleeping properly!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("I was just making sure you were sleeping properly!")
it: S-sono venuta solo a controllare che dormissi come si deve!

jp_grezzo: "「なによ…ジロジロ見ないで！」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("What...don't stare at me!")
it: Che c'è... non fissarmi così!

jp_grezzo: "「深い眠りで心と体を癒しなさいよ」"
en: Heal your body and mind with deep sleep.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Heal your body and mind with deep sleep.")
it: Cura il corpo e la mente con un sonno profondo.

jp: 「ちゃんと休んどるやん。よしよーし」
jp_grezzo: "「ちゃんと休んどるやん。よしよーし」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("You're resting properly. Okay, okay.")
it: Ti stai riposando come si deve. Bene, beeene.

jp: 「どぉも！夢の中まで見回りヤカちゃんやで～」
jp_grezzo: "「どぉも！夢の中まで見回りヤカちゃんやで～」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Do-mo! Yaca-chan patrols even in your dreams~.")
it: Salve! Sono la Yaca in ronda, e arrivo anche nei sogni~

jp: 「ねぇんねん～ころりよ～♪おこぉろ～りよ～♪」
jp_grezzo: "「ねぇんねん～ころりよ～♪おこぉろ～りよ～♪」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Twinkle twinkle little coin~ How I wonder where you are...")

jp: 「…眠っていたら抵抗できない…よね？」
jp_grezzo: "「…眠っていたら抵抗できない…よね？」"
en: ...If you're asleep, you can't resist...right?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("...If you're asleep, you can't resist...right?")
it: ...Se dormi non puoi resistere... vero?

jp: 「ねぇ…夢でも…逢えたね…」
jp_grezzo: "「ねぇ…夢でも…逢えたね…」"
en: Hey...even in a dream...we met...
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Hey...even in a dream...we met...")
it: Ecco... ci siamo incontrati anche nel sogno...

jp_grezzo: "「今…君の寝顔も見ているよ…」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Now... I'm watching your sleeping face...")
it: Adesso... sto guardando anche il tuo viso che dorme...

jp: 「短い命の多くを無駄な眠りに費やすとは、生身の体とは不自由なものだ。だが今はそう、休むがいい。また私に仕えるために」
jp_grezzo: "「短い命の多くを無駄な眠りに費やすとは、生身の体とは不自由なものだ。だが今はそう、休むがいい。また私に仕えるために」"
en: Flesh and blood, how pathetic to waste much of your limited life sleeping. But rest well for now, for you will need to serve me again.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Flesh and blood, how pathetic to waste much of your limited life sleeping. But rest well for now, for you will need to serve me again.")
it: Sprecare tanta parte di una vita breve in un sonno inutile: che cosa scomoda, un corpo di carne. Ma per adesso riposa, sì. Per poter servirmi di nuovo.

jp: 「いいわ、少しの間だけ首枷を外してあげる。存分に休息を楽しみなさい」
jp_grezzo: "「いいわ、少しの間だけ首枷を外してあげる。存分に休息を楽しみなさい」"
en: Fine, I'll unshackle you for a little while. Enjoy your sleep. But remember kitty, if you cheat on me in your dream, you'll never see a daylight again.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Fine, I'll unshackle you for a little while. Enjoy your sleep. But remember kitty, if you cheat on me in your dream, you'll never see a daylight again.")

jp: 「旅の疲れを癒すがよい。我が消えることなき紅蓮の炎が、夜のとばりに紛れる邪なる者から汝を守るであろう」
jp_grezzo: "「旅の疲れを癒すがよい。我が消えることなき紅蓮の炎が、夜のとばりに紛れる邪なる者から汝を守るであろう」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Relieve your fatigue. May the eternal flame protect you from the filthy beings that crawl in the shroud of night.")

jp: 「寝るの？本当に寝るの？おやつみ！」
jp_grezzo: "「寝るの？本当に寝るの？おやつみ！」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Are you going to sleep? Really sleepy? Good night!")

jp: 「フハハハハ。付いて行くぞぉ、夢の中までも」
jp_grezzo: "「フハハハハ。付いて行くぞぉ、夢の中までも」"
en: Muwahaha! I'll be following you, to your dream.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Muwahaha! I'll be following you, to your dream.")
it: Mwahahaha. Ti seguo, fino dentro il sogno.

jp_grezzo: "「お、おやすみのキスなんて…絶対にやだからね！」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("I-I'll never give you a good night kiss...ever!")
it: I-il bacio della buonanotte... non se ne parla proprio!

jp: 「100gpで子守唄を歌ってやろか…って、なんやもう寝てしもうたんかい！」
jp_grezzo: "「100gpで子守唄を歌ってやろか…って、なんやもう寝てしもうたんかい！」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("I'll sing you a lullaby for 100gp... Hey, what? You're already asleep?!")
it: Per 100 monete d'oro ti canto la ninna nanna... ma come, dormi già?!

jp: 「おやすみ…明日…また朗らかな芽を吹いておくれ」
jp_grezzo: "「おやすみ…明日…また朗らかな芽を吹いておくれ」"
en: Good night...May a bright sprout brought forth tomorrow...
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Good night...May a bright sprout brought forth tomorrow...")
it: Buonanotte... e domani... torna a mettere un germoglio sereno.

jp: 「戻ってきたか。案外ホネのある奴だな」
jp_grezzo: "「戻ってきたか。案外ホネのある奴だな」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Ah, you've returned. You're tougher than I thought.")
it: Ah, di nuovo qui. Hai più fegato di quanto pensassi.

jp_grezzo: "「どこホッツキ歩いてたのよ。もっと調教が必要ね」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Where were you until now? You need more breaking, it seems.")

jp: 「定命の者よ、よくぞ戻ってきた」
jp_grezzo: "「定命の者よ、よくぞ戻ってきた」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("And so the mortal returns. You shall serve me again.")

jp_grezzo: "「みゃみゃ？帰って来たの？来たの？たくさん待ってたよ！」"

en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Wheeee♪ You are back? You are back!")

jp_grezzo: "「フハハハハハ！！おかえり」"
en: Muwahahahahaha! Welcome back.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Muwahahahahaha! Welcome back.")
it: Mwahahahaha!! Eccoti di nuovo qui.

jp: 「べ、別にアンタが帰ってくるのを待ってたんじゃないからね！」
jp_grezzo: "「べ、別にアンタが帰ってくるのを待ってたんじゃないからね！」"
en: N-no...I-I wasn't looking for you! Silly!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("N-no...I-I wasn't looking for you! Silly!")
it: N-non è che stessi aspettando il tuo ritorno, sappilo!

jp: 「やっと帰ってきたんやな！さぁ、今日もバリバリ稼ぐんやで！」
jp_grezzo: "「やっと帰ってきたんやな！さぁ、今日もバリバリ稼ぐんやで！」"
en: You finally came back! Let's get to work making money!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("You finally came back! Let's get to work making money!")
it: Finalmente sei di ritorno! Forza, anche oggi si guadagna di gusto!

jp: 「おかえり…待っていた」
jp_grezzo: "「おかえり…待っていた」"
en: Welcome back... I was... waiting for you.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Welcome back... I was... waiting for you.")
it: Sei di ritorno... ti aspettavo...
